mintAuthority.summary: Native standalone uMINT has one default-admin EOA and a separate minter/burner EOA. Mint bytecode is non-upgradeable, but roles, transfer rules and issuer accounting remain privileged.
mintAuthority.headline: A default administrator and a separate minter can issue uncapped shares; immutable bytecode does not constrain their issuance authority.

controls.label: Native uMINT role-gated issuance surface

sources.label: DigiFT native uMINT disclosure within STEP2 application (March 20, 2025)

controls.evidence: Pinned deployment-to-block-26197389 role-event replay (seven grants/revocations; no RoleAdminChanged events) and all nine role checks establish default-admin 0xdac87349d8afd2989515deadb3692bb8edf749c4 and MINTER/BURNER 0x3797416c447778b514939362cf1b41bbe23dcf58. The latter has ENFORCER_ROLE=false, correcting the prior role-hash misidentification. Both controllers return getCode=0x. Default admin inherits every role, including mint and TA force transfer. Former minter/burner 0xc5572d1b0202194e5194eb925624754eebf89f60 has no effective roles. Verified standalone CMTAT_EVCC has no proxy, delegatecall fallback or mint-logic upgrade entrypoint. Privileged setRuleEngine changes transfer validation, not bytecode; no economic mint cap is implemented. RPC https://api-ethereum-mainnet.n.dwellir.com at block 26197389 (2026-10-15T10:42:59Z).

controls.label: uMINT default-admin EOA
controls.evidence: Exhaustive role-event replay and hasRole reads at block 26197389 establish DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and inherited BURNER_ROLE, DEBT_CREDIT_EVENT_ROLE, DEBT_ROLE, ENFORCER_ROLE, MINTER_ROLE, PAUSER_ROLE, SNAPSHOOTER_ROLE and TA_ROLE. getCode=0x. This default admin can mint without an economic cap, freeze, force transfer and change the rule engine. Organizational signer identity and custody are not attested.

controls.label: uMINT minter and burner EOA
controls.evidence: At block 26197389, complete role-event replay and hasRole calls establish only MINTER_ROLE and BURNER_ROLE. DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, ENFORCER_ROLE, PAUSER_ROLE, TA_ROLE, SNAPSHOOTER_ROLE, DEBT_ROLE and DEBT_CREDIT_EVENT_ROLE are false; getCode=0x. The earlier enforcer description confused the BURNER_ROLE hash with ENFORCER_ROLE. The admin can reassign roles. No cryptographic multisig or independently evidenced organizational threshold is inferred.

sources.label: Verified standalone uMINT source and ABI (no code-replacement path)
DigiFT native uMINT disclosure within STEP2 application (March 20, 2025)

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 26197389 (2026-10-15T10:42:59Z), complete deployment-to-pin role-event replay (seven grants/revocations, no admin-role changes) and all nine effective-role checks resolve default-admin 0xdac87349d8afd2989515deadb3692bb8edf749c4 and minter/burner 0x3797416c447778b514939362cf1b41bbe23dcf58. The separate minter has no enforcer or transfer-agent role. Former minter/burner 0xc5572d1b0202194e5194eb925624754eebf89f60 has no effective roles. Default admin inherits every role. Verified standalone source has uncapped mint and mutable transfer validation, without a mint-bytecode replacement path. RPC: https://api-ethereum-mainnet.n.dwellir.com. Native uMINT is distinct from DigiFT receipts. Public materials do not supply binding native PPM, current independent whole-supply financial reconciliation or the organizational identity, independence and MPC/HSM signing policies of the two code-empty controllers. DigiFT's native-fund legal disclosure states that the Singapore VCC fund is neither regulated nor supervised by MAS, although its investment manager holds a MAS capital-markets-services licence. Supervision none applies to the fund claim, not to the separately regulated manager or distributor.
